MILWAUKEE, Sept. 17, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Brady Corporation (NYSE: BRC) (“Brady” or “Company”), a world leader in identification, safety and productivity solutions, today announced that CEO Vineet Nargolwala and CFO Ann Thornton will present and host 1x1 meetings at the Sidoti Small Cap Virtual Conference taking place September 23 and 24, 2026.


The company presentation will take place on September 24, 2026, at 11:30 AM ET. To listen to the live webcast of the presentation please visit:[Sidoti Small Cap Virtual Conference](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=1UtcI-MDWdo3S-jGKt24h276oH5BeU0KL7GzaEPtkH6WgABOYgirI5tVpfzztdAlqTHGMLOiyMMU5t9VCDhgCymWe0aRlF0JNUWI41_QPLQUzt-eGoXq9d1gRKnJrreiZ7qUGgK38XbQb_Na9WHnmKv_wQIEasTE0tw2-g99ATuGDeb8KGvueqkGnAxgbzIK1R1f1Z1ekVyyVfNkd0SuuvPJAsGejPbWv6WiZYybSak2VSF_1ib075uuWdy3Ia7ujDY8B_7LhjejWX9ek8tUfNiOMRvRe9WFe6YkBSJ2LWW7fVRL5L2muzhElAb8dnLyJwIL1_gevxX-s06VcfLreX1eo8H4Pdq5KMgIHb5i8l0JAOvke53Xz2JXhOtQqmymYctJWGK9zhkMb0RmUKiEq7fMg2vvt-qaoEXPJU-1mErioMsVgmhvTLAZCctUbgnlOT0iLbzWVjfq0-ZLxuSNSCn3BJzgpRXqtRNbi60S_5hr8GY26qbx3gEiK4YP7DYF) .


To request a meeting with the Brady Team, please reach out to your Sidoti representative or email[investor@bradycorp.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=8FwACrXBEq2-QmJS4pKvPnULtHGtLoC_gJclkJ_w5FwQ9m35IPliMFSySAANcUAPw47JTxT03KeSqTRVEI43mEzPWHPKHu3PzoopL9u0iOQ=) .


Brady Corporation (NYSE: BRC) is a global industrial technology company and a leading provider of identification, safety, and productivity solutions that help organizations of all sizes to identify, connect, protect, track, and optimize what matters most. By combining trusted identification technologies with advanced data capture, enterprise mobility, software and workflow solutions, Brady’s comprehensive offerings enable its customers to improve safety, productivity, accuracy, and operational performance across their most critical functions and in the world’s most demanding environments. For more than 110 years, Brady has established trust and demonstrated its commitment to innovation, serving customers across manufacturing, logistics, healthcare, electronics, telecommunications, aerospace, construction, and other key industries, to make their work safer, smarter, and more connected. Headquartered in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, Brady employs approximately 9,300 people worldwide. Brady stock trades on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol BRC.
